title: fix: resolve TS6133 unused variable errors breaking console build
body:
`tsc` in `apps/console` fails with 4 `TS6133` errors in `SpecViewConfig.test.tsx` due to `noUnusedLocals` / `noUnusedParameters`. This breaks the CI build job and Bundle Analysis workflow. - Removed `capturedKanbanSchema` and `capturedCalendarSchema` module-level variables — assigned in mock callbacks but never read (tests assert via `screen.getByText()` instead) - Prefixed unused `props` → `_props` in `ObjectGrid` mock factories ```diff -let capturedKanbanSchema: any = null; -let capturedCalendarSchema: any = null; - -ObjectGrid: (props: any) =>
Grid
, +ObjectGrid: (_props: any) =>
Grid
, ```
Original prompt > fix all ci errors , build and test
